entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-05-28
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Extensions: public API for extension syntax in CREF #78738
  • Analyzer semantic diagnostics should not be reported when HasAllInformation = false #78737
  • ProjectSystemProject `_gate` gets blocked on client RPC requests causing slow sln load #78734

Closed

  • Adopt dotnet run-api in language server #78618
    .NET 10
  • Automatic restore should run even when the target is already loaded #78561
  • Unable to use extension everything to write a generic Cast that works with LINQ query comprehensions #78415
    Next
  • string initilizer giving compiler error on linux build #78098
  • Syntax error knocks out compiler error recovery leading to poor IDE experience #78627
    Backlog
  • [Automated] PRs inserted in VS build main-10627.53 #78723

PullRequests

Created

  • Implement compiler support for System.Runtime.InteropServices.ExtendedLayoutAttribute #78741
    Area-Compilers
  • Add Copilot Change Analysis to External Access #78739
    Area-IDE, Community, VSCode

    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything, Needs API Review
  • Update code to use null propagation #78733
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Update to using simple untyped lambdas #78732
    Area-Infrastructure, VSCode
  • Update to using unbound nameof(X<>) expressions #78731
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Avoid dereferencing null CheckConstraintsArgs.CurrentCompilation #78729
    Area-Compilers
  • Improve applicability to receiver type check for extension binary operators #78728
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything
  • Extensions: ignore static/instance mismatches for properties inside nameof #78725
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything

Merged

  • Invoke `dotnet run-api` to obtain virtual project #78648
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #78724
    Area-Infrastructure, Next
  • Do not convert tuple expression with error to a bad expression too early #78645
    Area-Compilers, Community, Next
  • Update persistence version #78727
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next
  • Add helper for mapping between documents and hierarchy+itemids #78726
    Area-IDE, Next
  • Extensions: nullability analysis for property access #78646
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything, Next
  • [release/dev17.14] Fix nullable crash for field keyword in partial property #78720

Updated

  • Add direct IVTs to internal projects #78742
    Area-IDE
